columns.label: Name
columns.reason: Primary identifier operators use to recognize an image.

columns.label: Family
columns.reason: Shows the image family for selecting related images.

columns.label: Status
columns.reason: Indicates whether the image is ready or in another lifecycle state.

columns.label: Architecture
columns.reason: Helps distinguish images by supported CPU architecture.

columns.label: Disk size (GB)
columns.reason: Provides a concise view of the image's disk size.

columns.label: Created
columns.reason: Helps identify when the image was created.

reason: Images are most useful in a table by name, family, readiness, architecture, and compact size and creation details.
